Its augmented, oriented integral boundary construction tests d^2=0 and uses exact ±1 unit cancellations with explicit Schur-complement operations and adjacent-differential restrictions, which preserve the integral chain homotopy type. It specifies 383 contractions leaving precisely one degree-two and 13 degree-three generators with all residual differentials zero, thereby proving integral freeness rather than just ranks over a field. H2 is rank one over Z, so an automorphism acts ±1; checking all 120 row-label permutations and their transposed partners modulo 101 validly distinguishes the two signs. For H3, the reduced simplicial signed Lefschetz sum for every group element combines with the known H2 action; the closed trace matches the standard four-, four-, and five-dimensional Specht characters. Rational semisimplicity proves the claimed decomposition. I inspected the algorithm and independently reconstructed the face counts; I did not independently reproduce all 383 integral cancellations or all 240 traces, so the bundled exhaustive checker is essential evidence, not a substitute for inspecting its logic.
